company.name: Job Today
company.shortDescription: Job Today is a fast-growing job discovery and messaging app connecting small businesses and local candidates.
company.description:
JOB TODAY is #1 hiring app for hospitality, retail and more. Currently in the UK, Spain and expanding to more countries, Job Today use mobile technology to help millions of people find a job the same day, specifically service and blue collar workers.

JOB TODAY is the easiest and fastest way to get a job in retail, restaurants and more. Apply with 1 tap, get a response in 24 hours, and ask employers questions via chat.

Getting a job with JOB TODAY is super easy and fast. Find hourly, part-time, or full-time employment wherever you are, 24/7. Apply with your profile in 1 tap – say adios to tedious cover letters and CVs for each application!

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application that connects small businesses with local job seekers, enabling job discovery and direct messaging between employers and candidates.
productsAndServices.name: Job Today Job Discovery and Messaging App

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $38,166,931 to $134,992,009, a 3.54x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 18 (-35 over 90 days) and market heat at 39 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Indeed, Snagajob, Job&Talent.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
